_comment: Full fine-tune (policy p2: backbone, depth decoder, lm_head, text_encoder_proj; text encoder and codec stay frozen) for 2x H100 80GB with plain DDP: accelerate launch --config_file configs/accelerate_multi_gpu.yaml --num_processes 2 train.py ... Trainable weights are kept as fp32 master copies (train.py upcasts them; matmuls still run in bf16 under autocast). gradient_accumulation_steps is the single-GPU value (4 -> 2 per GPU), global batch 4 x 2 x 2 = 16. LR 1e-5 (10x below the LoRA recipes) with longer warmup. Estimated, not measured on H100: 1.85B fp32 trainable params x (weights 4 + grads 4 + AdamW 8 bytes) ~ 30 GiB, + DDP gradient buckets ~7 GiB, + frozen bf16 text encoder/codec ~3 GiB, + checkpointed activations, so ~45 GiB per GPU; gradient checkpointing stays on for headroom. Each checkpoint is ~22 GiB (fp32 trainable weights + AdamW state), hence save_total_limit. For more headroom use configs/accelerate_deepspeed_zero2.yaml (shards AdamW state and grads).
